subject.title: Workspaces: persist widget state in SQLite

question: Should Workspaces make this parent-bound `state:persist` bridge and per-widget SQLite storage the supported durable-state contract for approved custom widgets?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it permanently expands the sandbox-to-parent capability surface and persisted plugin data model, which requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Approve the bounded contract
options.body: Accept this additive capability and RPC design after browser lifecycle proof is added and the closing issue reference is corrected.

options.title: Restrict to trusted widgets
options.body: Keep persistence internal to first-party widgets and remove the custom-iframe capability if durable writes from agent-authored widgets are not an accepted boundary.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Pause or close this PR until the broader Workspaces roadmap defines a different shared widget-state and upgrade contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded contract
recommendation.body: Accept this additive capability and RPC design after browser lifecycle proof is added and the closing issue reference is corrected.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Workspaces foundation and its plugin, SQLite, gateway, sandbox, and UI ownership boundaries were integrated through this person's merged work.
